guide_blurb: Bigger, darker, and a long way from the grass.
_tuning_notes: Barbary-type lion for badlands: the darker half of the source texture set, slightly larger and tougher. Same entity class and pride logic as the savanna lion — this is the registry doing the work, not Java. RARITY: tier 'rare', pride 3-4, nearby_cap 6. BABY SIZE 0.4.2: baby_scale moved 0.5 -> 1.0. The client already bakes the baby mesh through vanilla's BabyModelTransform (body halved, head full size) and vanilla age scaling halves the hitbox, so a 0.5 here was a SECOND shrink and calves rendered at a quarter of adult size. 1.0 = vanilla baby proportions.
